description: Public Electric Vehicle Charging Stations and Alternative Fuel Stations in Maryland is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. It takes a lot of fuel to move Marylanders from point “A” to point “B.” The Maryland Energy Administration (MEA) offers incentives to reduce the amount of energy residents expend on travel. Coverage: Maryland. The portal files it under the category Energy and Environment. Its tags are electric vehicle, energy, ethanol, ev, liquefied petroleum gas. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Maryland Energy Administration. The portal shows 2014-02-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
